chunks: O God, our Lord, send down upon us a table [of food] from the sky, which will be a feast for us, for the first of us and the last, and a sign from You. Give us sustenance, for You are the best of providers.

key_terms.مَائِدَة: Table of food, specifically the miraculous meal sent from heaven

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication of Jesus (AS) for the descent of the table from heaven?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this supplication (Du'a) is often recited to invoke divine sustenance and spiritual confirmation, reflecting the event of Al-Ma'idah where twelve disciples requested a heavenly feast. It underscores the concept of 'Ayah' (sign) not merely as a miracle but as a means to strengthen faith and serve as a perpetual reminder of God's providence for the believers.
